request.query: LiouvilleWith invariant under multiplication by nonzero rational preserving exponent

items.name: LiouvilleWith.mul_rat
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ} {r : ℚ}, LiouvilleWith p x → r ≠ 0 → LiouvilleWith p (x * ↑r)

items.name: LiouvilleWith.rat_mul
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ} {r : ℚ}, LiouvilleWith p x → r ≠ 0 → LiouvilleWith p (↑r * x)

items.name: LiouvilleWith.mul_rat_iff
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ} {r : ℚ}, r ≠ 0 → (LiouvilleWith p (x * ↑r) ↔ LiouvilleWith p x)

items.name: LiouvilleWith.rat_mul_iff
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ} {r : ℚ}, r ≠ 0 → (LiouvilleWith p (↑r * x) ↔ LiouvilleWith p x)

items.name: LiouvilleWith.mul_nat
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, LiouvilleWith p x → n ≠ 0 → LiouvilleWith p (x * ↑n)

items.name: LiouvilleWith.nat_mul
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, LiouvilleWith p x → n ≠ 0 → LiouvilleWith p (↑n * x)
